summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, conducting high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of RAF Kinloss, up to 24,500 ft, Monday to Thursday 12:00-20:00.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 573857N 0033338W (RAF KINLOSS). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE 
TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218. AR-2026-11234/01.
